annotations.title: Section 538 income limits and rent caps

description: FY2026 USDA Section 538 income limits (115% of area median income, 1 to 8 persons, effective July 13, 2026) for a county or USDA area in one state, with the per-unit rent cap (30% of the limit / 12) and the approximate project-average cap. Without county or area, lists every area in the state, paged.

area.description: USDA area name or its start, e.g. "Des Moines" or "Iowa County, IA".

county.description: County or parish name, e.g. "Jones" or "Jones County". Matched to a USDA area through this site's OMB 2023 metro delineation match.

household_size.description: Household size used for the rent caps (default 4).

limit.description: How many rows to return (1 to 50, default 10).
